parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes birth-sex passport, entry, facility, shelter and custody rules nationally and in this state, with religious-refusal immunity and no statewide equality protection. Document discrepancy can trigger refusal and a possible lifetime fraud finding; facility exclusion can trigger trespass and birth-sex custody, where conversion practices and immigration-detention abuse are documented. Functioning courts, employment/hate-crime protections, city ordinances and litigation mitigate some harms but do not cancel these universal, state-enforced exposures. Imprisonment is possible through secondary offences, execution is not credible.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex policy; passports processed only M/F per supporting documents, X stopped, Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025. External cable: document discrepancy or doubt about sex leads to refusal; suspected wilful misrepresentation may support permanent fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry for nationals; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, some waivers possible. Civil-liberties suit challenges marker policy.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch at entry can escalate from secondary screening to refusal, then fraud investigation and lifetime ineligibility, affecting adult and family travel.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Facility bans extend to prisons/dormitories; national corrections policy from 2026 adopts hair-cutting, hormone removal and psychiatric substitution described as conversion therapy. Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse of trans men.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Trespass example required willful entry plus refusal to depart; detention is not automatic on facility entry. Courts have enjoined several executive orders.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Entry/facility encounter can lead to detention and birth-sex placement; documented custody harms then become operative, with limited effective remedy shown.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal policy bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity. State March 2025 statute defines woman/man binary, covers bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters, rape-crisis centres, dormitories and prisons. No arrest under this state statute is documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Many jurisdictions nationally have no mapped ban, but this state is rated in worst-policy group; 15 cities offer local protections, though nullification was proposed.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal and state bans combine: visitor cannot rely on city protection in state/national facilities, shelters or custody settings.

care_services.exposure: State bans puberty blockers, hormones and surgery for minors except severe dysphoria by two physicians. Adult public-insurance exclusion was overturned then reinstated by appeals court in 2026; challenge pending. National orders target gender-affirming care for minors.
care_services.protection: Adult exclusion is still being challenged; emergency care consequences for visitors are not documented in dossier.
care_services.interaction: Travelling with a minor seeking continuity of care faces state ban and potential school outing/medical scrutiny; adult medication continuity is uncertain after custody or facility encounters.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National orders frame trans identity as binary noncompliance, direct investigations of schools/teachers facilitating social transition, and counterterrorism language prioritising radicals pro-transgender groups. Poll shows 66% support birth-sex on documents.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National employment discrimination prohibition and federal hate-crime statute apply; several orders blocked or enjoined and litigation unresolved.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile framing increases police, border and institutional discretion at entry, facilities and custody, while litigation creates unpredictability rather than safety.

minors_guardians.exposure: State athletics, minor care ban, proposed immediate parental outing of trans/nonbinary/intersex students, national sports-entry ban and teacher-prosecution directive expose minors and guardians to outing, exclusion and investigation.
minors_guardians.protection: Final status of student-outing bill and athletics ban unresolved; appeals court had struck athletics ban before national Supreme Court agreed to hear it.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling minor may face school/sport exclusion and outing; a guardian may be investigated or denied services, and entry discrepancy can affect the whole family itinerary.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No documented pattern of visitor street attacks in this state is provided. State permits religious-refusal denial of business, housing and government service with qualified immunity, creating service-denial exposure.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Federal hate-crime law covers gender identity; 15 cities bar discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodations, but statewide protection is absent.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police may enforce facility/document rules while religious-refusal immunity limits complaint recourse for service denial; municipal protections depend on location.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit remains challenged/unresolved, several executive orders enjoined, athletics and adult-care cases pending, local-ordinance nullification and student-outing bills unresolved. Enforcement of March 2025 facility statute is not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts, legal-aid FAQ, city ordinances and hate/employment law provide partial recourse; no remedy is documented as reliably working for visitors denied entry or facilities.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Unresolved litigation cuts both ways: protections may be enjoined, but hostile passport and facility rules are currently operative in key parts.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar or slightly safer: both have routine state exclusion at borders/facilities with weak appeals. This case adds US-style courts, city protections and no documented routine police confiscation, but adds custody-conversion and immigration-abuse severity.

Similar to somewhat lower: 0.45-D has universal registration and outing with uncommon imprisonment. Here passport/entry fraud risk, shelter/prison facility bans and documented custody abuse add severity beyond registration alone.

Lower than 0.55-B: that anchor is mainly discretionary secondary screening and refused admission with slow appeals. This combined regime adds Supreme-Court-backed binary passports, multi-setting facility bans, religious-refusal immunity and birth-sex custody practices.

Materially lower than 0.75-C: that anchor accepts matching markers, trains officers and provides tribunal review and compensation. Here binary documents, entry refusal/fraud exposure and state facility/custody bans are operative without comparable visitor remedy.

parsed.synthesis: The operative interaction is document or presentation mismatch leading to entry refusal or fraud scrutiny, facility exclusion, possible trespass detention, and birth-sex custody where harmful practices are documented. National employment and hate-crime law, city ordinances, injunctions and pending suits provide partial, uneven recourse but do not displace federal entry rules, state facility law, or immunity for religious refusals. For minors, care, sport and outing rules compound exposure. This universal state-enforced regime places the case below bureaucratic-friction anchors, above routine raids/extortion anchors, at 0.40.
